question: With which of the following states does Bangladesh NOT share its border?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Nagaland.**__

__
 
• Tripura, Assam, West Bengal, Meghalaya, Mizoram are the Indian state that shares their border with Bangladesh. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• States with international borders:
 
• The Indian States which shares an international border with **Pakistan (3,323 km)**:
 
 
• Gujarat, Rajasthan, Punjab, Jammu & Kashmir, Ladakh (3 states & 2 Union Territory share their borders with Pakistan)
 
 
 
• The Indian States which shares an international border with **China (3,488 km)**:
 
 
• Ladakh, Himachal Pradesh, Uttarakhand, Sikkim and Arunachal Pradesh (4 states and 1 UT share their borders with China)
 
 
 
• The Indian States which shares an international border with **Nepal (1,751 km):**
 
 
• Uttarakhand, Uttar Pradesh, Bihar, West Bengal, Sikkim (5 states shares its border with Nepal)
 
 
 
• Indian states which shares an international border with **Bhutan (699 km):**
 
 
• Sikkim, West Bengal, Assam, Arunachal Pradesh (4 states shares border with Bhutan)
 
 
 
• Indian states which shares international border with **Myanmar (1,643 km)**:
 
 
• Arunachal Pradesh, Nagaland, Manipur, Mizoram (4 states shares its border with Myanmar)
